#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const double PI = acos(-1.0);

// Fast integer input using getchar_unlocked
inline int fastInt() {
    int ret = 0;
    char c = getchar_unlocked();
    while (c <= ' ') c = getchar_unlocked();
    bool neg = (c == '-');
    if (neg) c = getchar_unlocked();
    do {
        ret = ret * 10 + (c - '0');
    } while ((c = getchar_unlocked()) >= '0' && c <= '9');
    return neg ? -ret : ret;
}

double getAngle(const vector<int>& p1, const vector<int>& p2, const vector<int>& p3) {
    double dot = 0, aLen = 0, bLen = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        dot += (p2[i] - p1[i]) * (p3[i] - p1[i]);
        aLen += (p2[i] - p1[i]) * (p2[i] - p1[i]);
        bLen += (p3[i] - p1[i]) * (p3[i] - p1[i]);
    }
    return 180.0 * acos(dot / sqrt(aLen * bLen)) / PI;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n = fastInt();
    if (n > 20) {
        cout << "0\n";
        return 0;
    }

    vector<vector<int>> p(n, vector<int>(5));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 5; ++j) {
            p[i][j] = fastInt();
        }
    }

    vector<int> good;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        bool ok = true;
        for (int j = 0; j < n && ok; ++j) {
            if (i == j) continue;
            for (int k = j + 1; k < n && ok; ++k) {
                if (i == k) continue;
                if (getAngle(p[i], p[j], p[k]) < 90.0) {
                    ok = false;
                }
            }
        }
        if (ok) good.push_back(i + 1);
    }

    cout << good.size() << "\n";
    for (int idx : good) {
        cout << idx << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
